title: Absolute Path
description:
Returns the absolute path of a string for example

"plugins/test.txt" would return
c://ect../myserver/plugins/test.txt"

title: Addon List
description: Gets a list of the addons on the server, this can also be used to get the number (size)

title: Ascii To String
description: Converts Ascii (Symbol number from the ascii table) to string

title: Ascii To Unicode
description: Converts a single Ascii value to a Unicode value
syntax_pattern:
convert ascii %number% to unicode
ascii %numbers% as unicode

title: Attribute of File
description:
Returns the value of the files attribute as a boolean

Sets a attribute of a file (read/write/hidden) to a boolean

title: Binary To Decimal
description: Converts a Binary string in to a decimal
syntax_pattern:
convert bin[ary] %string% to decimal
bin[ary] %string% as decimal

title: Binary To Hexadecimal
description: Converts Binary to a Hexadecimal
syntax_pattern:
convert bin[ary] %string% to hexa[decimal]
bin[ary] %string% as hexa[decimal]

title: Binary To Octal
description: Converts Binary to an Octal Int
syntax_pattern:
convert bin[ary] %string% to octal
bin[ary] %string% as octal

title: Binary To String
description: Converts Binary "01010010 01010010" ect.. in to a String (Must use spaces)

title: Contents from URL
description: Gets the contents from a URL, and returns it as an array (list variable)

title: Convert String to Lowercase
description: Converts a string to lowercase

title: Convert String to Uppercase
description: Converts a string to uppercase

title: Date Infomation
description: Returns Information from a date.
syntax_pattern:
(year|month|month name|day of year|day of month|day of week|day name|hours|minutes|seconds) from date %date%
date %date%'s (year|month|month name|day of year|day of month|day of week|day name|hours|minutes|seconds)

title: Date Parsed
description:
Parses a string as a date, needed for %date% elements.

"dd" = Days, "MM" = Months, "yy" = Years (16), "yyyy" = Years (2016)
"HH" = Hours, "mm" = Minutes, "ss" = Seconds

title: Date to Unix
description: Converts a date (like "now" to unix)
syntax_pattern:
convert date %date% to unix[ date]
date %date% as unix[ date]

title: Decimal To Binary
description: Converts a Decimal to Binary
syntax_pattern:
convert decimal %number% to bin[ary]
decimal %string% as bin[ary]

title: Directory Size
description: Gets the size of a directory
syntax_pattern:
size of dir[ectory] %string%[ in bytes]
dir[ectory] %string%'s size[ in bytes]

title: Disk Space
description: Returns disk space

title: Encode or Decode Base64
description:
Encode a string to base64 using UTF-8 as the Charset
Decode a string from base64 using UTF-8 as the Charset

title: Encode or Decode Morse
description:
Encodes a string to morse code
Decodes a morse string to a english string
syntax_pattern:
encode morse[ code] %string%
decode morse[ code] %string%

title: Encrypt or Decrypt String
description:
Encrypts a String if you use AES You have to use a key with the length 16, 24, 32 chars
Decrypts a String if you use AES You have to use a key with the length 16, 24, 32 chars
syntax_pattern:
encrypt %string% using %string% with key %string%
decrypt %string% using %string% with key %string%

title: File Contents
description:
Returns the contents of a file

Sets,gets or resets contents of file

title: File Extension
description: Returns the file extension of a file

title: File Last Modified, Last Accessed, Creation Date
description: Returns when the file was last changed (modified), last accessed, and created
syntax_pattern:
file %string%'s (last modified|creation|last access) value
(last modified|creation|last access) value of file %string%

title: File Line Count
description: Returns the line count of a file
syntax_pattern:
line count of file %string%
file %string%'s line count

title: File Name
description: Gets the name of a file with out the extension

title: File Owner
description:
Gets or Sets the file owner
Note: Can only set the owner to a real user

title: File Size
description: Returns the size of the file
syntax_pattern:
size of file %string%[ in bytes]
file %string%'s size[ in bytes]

title: Files in Directory
description: Returns a list of the files in the current and sub directories
syntax_pattern:
files in dir[ectory] [including sub dir[ectorie]s)] %string%
dir[ectory] [including sub dir[ectorie]s)] %string%'s files

title: Files in Zip File
description: Returns a list of files in the zip file
syntax_pattern:
files in zip[ file] %string%
zip[ file] %string%'s files

title: Hash String
description: Gets the Hash of the string.

title: Hex To RGB
description: Converts a Hex color value in to a Rgb color value formated like "200, 200, 200"
syntax_pattern:
convert hex %string% to rgb
hex %string% as rgb

title: Hexadecimal to Binary
description: Convert a Hexadecimal to Binary
syntax_pattern:
convert hexa[decimal] %string% to bin[ary]
hexa[decimal] %string% as bin[ary]

title: Hexadecimal To Number
description: Converts a Hexadecimal to a Number
syntax_pattern:
convert hexa[decimal] %string% to num[ber]
hexa[decimal] %string% as num[ber]

title: Is Os
description: Checks if your server's os a certain os
syntax_pattern:
(operating system|os) is (windows|mac|linux|unix|solaris|sun os|hp ux|aix|irix|free bsd|open bsd|net bsd)
(operating system|os) is(n'| no)t (windows|mac|linux|unix|solaris|sun os|hp ux|aix|irix|free bsd|open bsd|net bsd)

title: Json Value
description: Gets the contents from a single json value
syntax_pattern:
content of json value %string% from text %-string%
value %string%'s json contents from text %-string%

title: Json Values
description: Gets the contents from a multiple json value's
syntax_pattern:
content of json value's %strings% from text %-string%
value's %strings%'s json contents from text %-string%

title: Last Execute command Output
description: Returns the last bash/batch/sh command's output

title: Line from URL
description: Gets a line from a URL and returns it.

title: List of TimeZones
description: Returns an array (list variable) of all the supported TimeZones.

title: Loaded Commands
description: Returns Loaded Commands as a number

title: Loaded Conditions
description: Returns loaded conditions from all addons and skript

title: Loaded Effects
description: Returns loaded effects from all addons and skript

title: Loaded Events
description: Returns the number of events from all addon and skript

title: Loaded Expressions
description: Returns loaded Expressions from all addons and skript

title: Loaded Functions
description: Returns loaded Functions as a number

title: Loaded Scripts
description: Returns loaded skripts as a number

title: Loaded Statements
description: Returns the number of loaded statements

title: Loaded Triggers
description: Returns Loaded Triggers as a numbers

title: Loaded Variables
description: Returns loaded variables as a number

title: Mirror String
description:
Reverses a string
Example "hello" would turn in to "olleh"

title: Number Of Chars
description: Returns the number of upper or lower case chars in a string

title: Number To Hexadecimal
description: Converts a Number to it's Hexadecimal Form
syntax_pattern:
convert num[ber] %number% to hexa[decimal]
num[ber] %number% as hexa[decimal]

title: Octal To Binary
description: Converts an Octal Int to it's binary form
syntax_pattern:
convert octal %string% to bin[ary]
octal %string% as bin[ary]

title: Plugin List
description: Gets a list of the plugin on the server, this can also be used to get the number (size)

title: Ram
description: Returns free/total/max ram

title: Randomize String
description: Randomizes a string

title: Read Line in File
description: Reads a line in a file

title: Region of Server
description:
Returns the region of the server.

Example: "Europe/London"

title: Relative Path
description: Gets the relative path of a file

title: RGB to Hex
description: Converts a rgb color to a hex color
syntax_pattern:
convert rgb %number, %number, %number to hex
rgb %number%, %number%, %number% as hex

title: Short Path
description: Returns short path of a path

title: SSL Algorithm
description: Return's the SSL Certificate's Algorithm
syntax_pattern:
ssl algorithm of url %string%
url %string%'s ssl algorithm

title: SSL Expire Value
description: Returns the SSL Certificate's Expire date as a unix timestamp
syntax_pattern:
ssl expire value of url %string%
url %string%'s ssl expire value

title: SSL Issue Value
description: Returns the SSL Certificate's Issue Date as a unix timestamp
syntax_pattern:
ssl issue value of url %string%
url %string%'s ssl issue value

title: SSL Serial Number
description: Returns the SSL Certificate's Serial Number as a hexadecimal
syntax_pattern:
ssl serial number of url %string%
url %string%'s ssl serial number

title: SSL Verifier
description:
Returns the SSL signer/verifier of a url
Example: DigiCert
syntax_pattern:
ssl verifier of url %string%
url %string%'s ssl verifier

title: SSL Version
description:
Returns SSL Certifiicate's Version as a Number
Example: 3
syntax_pattern:
ssl version of url %string%
url %string%'s ssl version

title: String To Ascii
description: Converts Text or symbols in to it's number on the ascii table

title: String to Binary
description: Converts a String to Binary

title: String to Unicode
description: Converts text (char) to Unicode, accepts more than one char input

title: System Property
description: Return a System Property
syntax_pattern: system property (os arch|os name|os version|java home|user dir|user home|user name|user lang[uage]|user timezone|line separator|file separator|path separator|file encoding)

title: System Time
description: Returns current System nanoseconds, milliseconds or seconds

title: Time In TimeZone
description:
Gets the current time In a TimeZone, support for GMT+1,GMT-1 ect..
formatted just like your config is, Case Sensitive!

title: TimeZone of server
description:
Returns the TimeZone of the server.

Example: GMT

title: Unicode To Ascii
description: Converts unicode (/u2588) to Ascii (9608), Accepts more than one input
syntax_pattern:
convert unicode %string% to ascii
unicode %string% as ascii

title: Unicode To String
description: Converts string tounicode

title: Unix To Date
description: Converts a Unix date to a normal date formatted like just like you have it set in skript's config!
syntax_pattern:
convert unix[ date] %number% to date
unix[ date] %number% as date

title: Unix To Date Formatted
description:
Converts a unix date to a date formatted how you want!

"dd" = Days, "MM" = Months, "yy" = Years (16), "yyyy" = Years (2016)
"HH" = Hours, "mm" = Minutes, "ss" = Seconds
syntax_pattern:
convert unix[ date] %number% to date formatted as %string%
unix[ date] %number% as date formatted as %string%

title: URL Last Modified
description: Gets the page's last modified date and returns as a unix timestamp
syntax_pattern:
last modified value of url %string%
url %string%'s last modified value

title: URL Line Count
description: Returns the line count from a web page (url)
syntax_pattern:
line count of url %string%
url %string%'s line count

title: URL Online State
description: Checks the online state of a webpage/site and returns true if it's up
syntax_pattern:
online stat(us|e) of url %string%
url %string%'s online stat(us|e)

title: URL Response Code
description:
Returns the response code from a url (web page)
Example: 200 (OK), 404 (Not Found/Offline)
Full List: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_HTTP_status_codes
syntax_pattern:
response code of url %string%
url %string%'s response code

title: URL Size
description: Returns the size of a web page (from url)
syntax_pattern:
size of url %string%[ in bytes]
url %string%'s size[ in bytes]

title: Version
description: Returns the version of plugin, java, server, os, or my aliases version

title: On Command Run
description: Triggers when you execute bash/batch/sh code

title: On File Copy
description:
Executes every time you try to copy a file to a directory, can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get file to copy
Use: event-string to get directory to copy to

title: On File Creation
description:
Executes every time you try to create a file, can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get file

title: On File Deletion
description:
Executes every time you try to delete a file, can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get the file

title: On File Download
description:
Executes every time you try to download, this can be cancelled
Use: event-string to get URL
Use: event-file to file download name

title: On File Execute
description:
Executes every time you try to run a file, this can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get file

title: On File Move
description:
Executes every time you try to move a file, can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get the file
Use: event-string to get the new location

title: On File Rename
description:
Executes every time you try to rename a file, can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get the file
Use: event-string to get the new name

title: On File Wipe
description:
Executes every time you try to wipe a file, can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get file

title: On File Write
description:
Executes every time you try to rename a file, can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get the file
Use: event-string to get the string to be written
Use: event-number to get the line number

title: On File Zip
description:
Executes every time you try to zip a file can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get the file
Use: event-string to get the zip

title: On Unzip
description:
Executes every time you try to unzip a file can be cancelled
Use: event-file to get the zip
Use: event-string to get the unzip to location

title: Copy Directory
description: Copies a directory and all sub-directories to another directory

title: Copy File
description: Copies a file to another directory

title: Create Directory
description: Creates a directory at a location you choose

title: Create File or App
description: Creates a file or at the location you give it

title: Delete Directory
description: Deletes a directory and all sub directories at the chosen path

title: Delete File or App
description: Deletes a file at the location you give it

title: Download File
description: Downloads a File from a url

title: Move Directory
description: Moves a directory to another directory

title: Move File
description: Moves a file to the location you tell it to

title: Reload Aliases
description: Reloads skripts aliases

title: Reload Config
description: Reloads a config of a plugin

title: Reload Script
description: Reloads a script

title: Reload Server
description: Reloads the server (This can be unsafe for most plugins)

title: Rename Directory
description: Renames the chosen directory

title: Rename File
description: Renames a file

title: Restart Server
description: Restarts the server using spigot

title: Run As Op
description: Forces the player to run a command as op

title: Run Command
description: Execute bash/batch/sh commands in skript #Windows: cmd /c

title: Run Script/File
description:
Runs the script (.bat / .sh / ect..) at /plugins + your string (path)
or you can run programs/files

title: Unzip File
description: Unzip's a zip file

title: Write Line in file
description: Changes a line in a file to the text you want it to have! #note this could wipe the file! (Very low chance)
syntax_pattern:
set line %number% in file %string% to %string%
set file %string%'s line %number% to %string%

title: Zip Directory
description: Add's a directory to a zip file with all the files and folders in that directory

title: Zip Files
description: Creates a new zip and adds a file to it, if that zip already exists it will create a new one! (Don't worry it doesn't overwrite)

title: File Exists
description: Checks if the file exists or doesn't exist

title: Is a Directory
description: Checks if a path is a Directory
syntax_pattern:
file %string% is a dir[ectory]
file %string% is(n'| no)t a dir[ectory]

title: Is a File
description:
Checks if the path is a file or a directory

Useful for loops
syntax_pattern:
file %string% is a file
file %string% is(n't| not) a file

title: Is Executable
description: Checks if a file is executable
syntax_pattern:
file %string% is exec[utable]
file %string% is(n't| not) exec[utable]

title: Is Symbolic
description: Checks if the file has a link with another file (example shortcut)

title: Is TimeZone
description: Checks if the server is a certain TimeZone.
syntax_pattern:
server is time[ ]zone %string%
server is(n't| no)t time[ ]zone %string%

title: String Ends With
description: Checks if a string ends with a certain string
syntax_pattern:
%string% ends with %-string%
%string% does(n't| not) end with %-string%

title: String Starts With
description: Checks if a string starts with a certain string
syntax_pattern:
%string% starts with %-string%
%string% does(n't| not) start with %-string%

title: Yaml Exists
description: Checks if a yaml path exists within a yaml file.
syntax_pattern:
y[a]ml[ path] %string% in file %-string% exists
y[a]ml[ path] %string% in file %-string% does(n't| not) exist

title: Yaml (skUtilities)
description:
Everything to do with yaml in skUtilities
Read/write/delete/remove
(%object% can be a string/boolean/number)
syntax_pattern:
y[a]ml value %string% (from|of) file %string%
set y[a]ml value %string% (from|of) file %string% to %object%
delete y[a]ml value %string% (from|of) file %string%
y[a]ml nodes %string% (from|of) file %-string%
add %object% to y[a]ml nodes %string% (from|of) file %string%
remove %object% from y[a]ml nodes %string% (from|of) file %string%
delete y[a]ml nodes %string% (from|of) file %string%
y[a]ml node[s with] keys %string% (from|of) file %-string%
add %object% to y[a]ml node[s with] keys %string% (from|of) file %string%
remove %object% from y[a]ml node[s with] keys %string% (from|of) file %string%
delete y[a]ml node[s with] keys %string% (from|of) file %string%
y[a]ml list %string% (from|of) file %-string%
add %object% to y[a]ml list %string% (from|of) file %string%
remove %object% from y[a]ml list %string% (from|of) file %string%
delete y[a]ml list %string% (from|of) file %string%

title: Insert Line
description:
Inserts a line of text at the given location in the given file, you can write to non-existant lines it will create empty lines for the ones before.
use the [Write Line in File](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=264) effect if you want to create a new line, only use insert line if you need to put a line between some lines or add a new line to a file
